messages:
alex: Heads up — canary failures observed on CUDA 12.2 marketplace AMIs in ap-southeast-1. Symptoms look like nv-driver / kernel module mismatches on a subset of our customer workloads. Impact: Dedicated + Marketplace images using nv-driver 530.x. Proposal: immediate temporary pin to 525.x for Marketplace AMIs until we validate a hotfix. Need partner sign-off and a hotfix window.

kevin: Can you paste the failing snippet and the exact node image ids?

alex: pasted logs + image ids below:
```
[2026-03-21T02:14:03Z] runtime: failed to init nvml: version mismatch, module not found
[2026-03-21T02:14:03Z] tail: /var/log/nvidia-installer.log: ERROR: kernel module load failed: -2
nodes affected: ami-0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c1 (ap-southeast-1a), ami-0c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d2 (ap-southeast-1b)
```

kevin: sounds like kernel ABI mismatch. Patch candidate is nv-driver 526.35 with a backported kernel symbol fix, but that needs full quant/int8 regression run. Can we run 20-node canary?

sophie: ROCm side: rocm-5.6 images look untouched so far, but we should double-check host kernel ABI surface for our onprem partners. Also if we pin CUDA driver, we must ensure our runtime kernels still match (attention kernels + fused ops).

maria: looping in partner contacts (cc @aws-marketplace, @hw-vendor). We need ETA on driver build & validation. Also we should prepare a marketplace buyer notice for a transient compatibility pin.

deploy-bot: CI canary -> 7/20 seeds failed on throughput + module load errors. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.

kevin: I'll fire the regression matrix tonight (quant kernels, int8, matmul fusing). If we can get <=0.5% regression on segbench, we can push 526.35. Otherwise we do pin 525.x + AMI repack. I can spin 20 nodes canary Tue 04:00 UTC.

alex: Schedule proposal: Option A (preferred): run canary Tue 04:00-06:00 UTC with 526.35; if green, push hotfix AMI and trigger marketplace repack. Option B: immediate pin to 525.x marketplace images for 2 weeks while we finish validation. Need partner agreement.

partner-ops: I'll coordinate vendor validation. HW vendor wants their infra canary first (they'll run against their fleet Tue 00:00-03:00 UTC). I'll aim to confirm by EOD. Also will prepare a short MOU for the hotfix window.

kevin: sample manifest for the temporary pin (for marketplace docs):
```
{
  "runtime": "redwood-inference-runtime",
  "cuda_driver": "525.85.12",
  "cuda_toolkit": "12.1",
  "rocm": "5.6 (unchanged)",
  "note": "Temporary compatibility pin applied due to kernel module regression; ETA for hotfix: 48-72h after canary"
}
```

sophie: also test on the quant-optimized kernels; I saw a different flop pattern with 526 in our microbenchmarks — will report any accuracy diffs.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft marketplace notice + FAQ snippet: quick bullet, impact, mitigation (pin + hotfix timeline), contact. We should also add a short note in the joint announcements freeze to avoid releasing new marketplace listings during the pin window.

alex: Decision for now: hold announcement freeze and prepare the pin path. Kevin / Sophie — run full regression matrix and post results here in 24h. Partner-ops — confirm vendor canary and sign-off. If regressions <=0.5% and vendor canary green, proceed with hotfix push; else we keep the 525 pin and extend.

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: Tue 04:00-06:00 UTC. Created PR: repo:infra/ami-repacks#842 (needs review).

partner-ops: Vendor confirmed preliminary green on their canary (small fleet). They want a staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and a rollback playbook. I'll attach their validation checklist to the PR.

maria: Comms template ready, will drop in #marketing and attach to the PR after we get final sign-off.

alex: Thanks — locking plan: immediate marketplace manifest update to pin to 525.x as contingency; run canary Tue 04:00 with 526.35 candidate; rollback thresholds set at >0.5% regression or any module load error. Keep this thread for final go/no-go.
